mechanism.claim: When at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals exhibit unusually strong positive first-order return persistence and finish in one common direction, broad crypto inventory is being executed sequentially rather than repriced in one isolated jump. During elevated BTC variation, propagate that persistent direction into BTC for eight hours only when exact 24-hour BTC open interest has expanded.
mechanism.side: strict common completed displacement sign among at least four positive-autocorrelation tail alts
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSRAR estimates BTC-only serial autocorrelation. HVABLR estimates directional lead-lag between an alt basket and BTC. HVCAPEC measures path efficiency without ordering information. HVCASPC separately estimates each alt own-lag five-minute return autocorrelation, ranks it by own causal history, and requires a common displacement direction; HVCASPCOIS adds only exact decision-available 24-hour BTC OI expansion to the frozen HVCASPC geometry; it uses no BTC direction, volume, funding, premium, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35 percent, while OI expansion identifies sponsored July-like volatile states
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: the conjunction of offset cross-alt serial-persistence breadth and exact 24-hour BTC OI sponsorship is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.alt_path: 96 exact five-minute aggregates per alt from 480 exact coherent bars_binance one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.alt_displacement: sum of 96 five-minute returns, strict nonzero
features.serial_persistence: sample Pearson correlation of returns[0:95] and returns[1:96], both sample standard deviations strict positive
features.persistence_rank: per-symbol strict-prior midrank of serial_persistence over at most 270 earlier jointly source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded
features.consensus: at least four tail alts have one common strict displacement sign; larger breadth wins and equal positive/negative breadth rejects
features.consensus_strength: median persistence_rank among selected-side tail alts
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTCUSDT one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.open_interest_start: exact BTCUSDT open_interest_binance period=5m at D-24h
features.open_interest_sponsorship: both endpoints finite strictly positive and log(OI_D/OI_D-24h)>0
features.eligible_state: source-valid persistence consensus, variation gate, and OI sponsorship
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid decision ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held-interval funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: broad sequential-order execution with causal BTC OI sponsorship

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, bar size, autocorrelation, history, rank, breadth, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
